verdict.rationale: Framer offers several programmatic surfaces. A Server API automates publishing and embeds Framer into products. A native external-agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex direct access to the canvas, components, CMS, and project context. Plugins can insert layers and modify anything on the canvas. However, no documentation claims that the API matches everything possible in the UI, and the Server API is described mainly in terms of publishing and CMS work. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, published API reference or OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), documented API coverage of settings, domains, branching, and staging, and independent hands-on corroboration.
